document_control.title: Consolidated Pre-Real-Data Owner Status
document_control.warning: NO ANALYSIS, BACKTESTING, SCORING, RECOMMENDATION OR TRADING AUTHORIZED

objective: Build an analysis-only Indian-market decision-support system whose data, features, outcomes, experiments, scores and confidence are point-in-time correct, deterministic, reproducible and evidence-backed.
standing_owner_decisions: Current development order accepted unless evidence requires a change.
Paid market-data providers will not be used.
Prefer free official NSE, SEBI and BSE sources; use AMFI only where mutual funds are relevant.
Kite Connect may supplement current data but is not historical-survivorship evidence.
version2.0 remains a separate comparison project and is not canonical.
Future visible outputs may include market-sentiment and individual-stock scores.
Scores remain hidden until sufficient evidence exists; untested outputs are non-actionable.
Live broker-related code may remain only when it cannot corrupt or override canonical data.
The project is analysis-only and must never execute trades.
The local F&O database may be audited later for trustworthiness.
Portfolio construction and some later presentation choices remain deferred.
Every analysis or backtest requires a current owner-review PDF gate and separate exact authorization.

milestones.result: Local-first modular monolith with typed Parquet facts, DuckDB analytics, SQLite workflow state and immutable evidence manifests.
Momentum v1 mechanics reproduced on a golden fixture and walk-forward machinery implemented; no actionable score.
Broad local equity directory is survivor-selected and insufficient for cross-sectional edge approval.
Provider-neutral ingestion exists; official sample produced 12 bhavcopies but only 3 dated population pairs; NSE permission response remains absent.
Kite supports bounded read-only current instruments, quotes and ephemeral health; no historical use or order endpoints.
Shared research contracts, promotion gates, evidence manifests, split access, owner-review gates and F&O audit safety plans were established.
Point-in-time pipeline, feature, outcome, walk-forward, economic and portfolio evidence mechanics validated on fictional data; holdout left unconsumed.
Incremental ingestion, schema drift, dependency rebuilding, immutable reuse and recovery validated.
Security events, causal identity, non-destructive adjustments and terminal-economics mechanics validated.
Exchange-calendar, decision-clock, execution-session, purge and embargo mechanics validated.
Multi-feature evidence, calibration, confidence, multiplicity and lifecycle semantics validated; no external decision.
Immutable evidence publication, freshness, supersession and read-only facade validated; outputs remain NO_DECISION.
Mandate, portfolio accounting and internal decision-policy mechanics validated; external result remains NO_DECISION.
Readiness audit found stale fingerprint assumptions and 14 missing executable entries; no engine defect or economic readiness.
Historical review semantics and cumulative 77-entrypoint inventory corrected forward-only.
Conflicting working-tree hashes reconciled; authoritative 280-file Git-object fingerprint is 19ed28f407ff62a44012f1d1e4b1870ba15be30155c9c19bee6288ab228f1bc6.

proposed_next_milestone.reason: It is the narrowest bounded step that can replace assumptions about an already-local candidate source with evidence, without running a strategy or acquiring external data.
scope: Bind the exact owner-approved local database through the existing private locator without publishing its path.
Prove read-only opening and preserve a versioned database identity.
Inspect schema, tables, columns, indexes and metadata under bounded timeouts.
Measure bounded date, symbol, contract, expiry and field coverage.
Check bounded duplicates, missingness, OHLC/volume/OI validity and continuity patterns.
Assess provenance, raw-source lineage, corrections, retained vintages and permitted use.
Produce a qualification verdict for possible later futures/options research.
exclusions: No strategy, feature, return, backtest, simulation, score or recommendation.
No database write, repair, export, sidecar, unrestricted scan or external acquisition.
Abort if read-only safety, bounded queries, provenance or access conditions cannot be established.
